body:
Now: once the house has its floors, there is little left to buy, and nothing costs money over time.
New:
- Dream items: a few big things to save for (1,500-5,000), e.g. a hot tub, a treehouse, a home cinema. Izabele picks which. Not part of the Pets and Farm Update.
- Keep the pet price list (economy-pfu-prices) as it is.
- Dropped (31 Oct): daily pet food cost. Pets have no hunger (rules-dec-one-need); food is one way to make them happy.
Pace with Balances 1-9 (estimate): job 330 + quests 140 + small extras 65 + level-ups about 50 = about 585 coins a game day = about 2,300 a real hour of normal play.
- Big pet with its home and pet yard level 3: up to 3,900 = about 1 hour 40 min
- Pet yard to level 3 (2,800): about 1 hour 15 min
- All 5 house floors (12,500): about 5.5 real hours (they also need Decorating 10-50)
Tapping and the claw no longer beat working.

comments.text: Approved by Karolis ('do the rebalance', 30 Oct). Not in this patch: pet food per day comes with pet needs (Pets and Farm Update); dream items wait for Izabele's picks.
Done: daily pet food cost dropped (pets have no hunger, 31 Oct).

short: Big dream items to save for (Izabele picks)
source: chat 2026-10-30: Schedules and economy red team
title: Balance 6: things to save up for, and small daily costs
